assertion_refresh_sql: SELECT ID_PERSON FROM T_WC_T2S_PERSON WHERE PERSON_NAME = 'Michael Caine' LIMIT 1
comment: FASTAPI-TEXT2SQL-218 / -214 / -215. The two-word form of a birth name TMDb stores as 'Maurice Joseph Micklewhite Jr.', so it is two tokens short, not one. On 2026-08-26 the trace never even named a Micklewhite: the ranker scored with WRatio, which grades a token subset ('Maurice Maurice') exactly like the real birth name, broke the tie on the highest TMDb id, and handed the gate an unrelated person to refuse (-218). Two extra tokens then defeated the first version of the -214 guard until generational suffixes were neutralised. The assertion is on the identity returned, not on the path taken. ID 3895 verified by Philippe against person.php on 2026-08-26.
